derivation:
by
  suffices 𝔞 ^ 3 - 𝔟 ^ 2 = 1728 * 𝔡 by simpa using congrArg ψ this
  ext z; simpa [𝔞, 𝔟, 𝔡, ofMF, mul_comm] using ((eq_div_iff (by norm_num)).mp (ModularForm.discriminant_eq_E₄_cube_sub_E₆_sq z)).symm
explanation: Mathlib independently proves Δ(z) = (E₄(z)³ − E₆(z)²)/1728. Clear the numerical denominator, use extensionality in niceSubalgebra, and apply ψ to obtain the stated Laurent-series identity.
